title: AT CALVARY
stanzas: Years I spent in vanity and pride, Caring not my Lord was crucified, Knowing not it was for me he died on calvary
By God's word at last my sin I learned; Then I trembled at the law I'd spurned, Till my guilty soul imploring turned to calvary
Now I've given to Jesus everything, Now I gladly own Him as my King, Now my raptured soul can sing of calvary!
Oh, the love that drew salvation's plan! Oh, the grace that brought it down to man! Oh, the mighty dulf that God did span at Calvary
chorus: Mercy there was great and grace was free; Pardon there was multiplied to me There my burdened soul found liberty at calvary
